name: Stykas-reported exposure across company networks (Wired, August 2026)

attribution.legal_posture: Unverified researcher-reported exposure; affected-company totals and access claims remain independently unestablished.

caveats: The reported company totals and extent of access await independent verification.
Sensitive material reportedly obtained from compromised systems and undisclosed victims stay out of the record.
The reported exposure stays within the cited source boundary; a natural-person identity requires additional evidence.

statements: Researcher Vangelis Stykas reported evidence of 1,640 affected companies in 57 countries, with approximately 700-800 suffering damaging access. The source describes root, cloud, developer-key, source-code, and cryptocurrency-wallet exposure across a broad victim set. It connects two access paths in the same ecosystem: Contagious Interview-style fake-job malware and fraudulent DPRK remote IT-worker employment. Several named organizations supplied differentiated responses, making this useful for incident-status and affected-organization analysis rather than treating every reported exposure as confirmed compromise.
